system.notes: Attached at the hip. Walking −2, running multiplier −2 (apply by hand). Not a cyberleg: no nerve link, no Strength modifier, and no modifications or other cyberware can be added (it can be hollowed out to hide something no wider than a fist and no longer than a forearm). Quickness counts lower for movement; the wearer can't walk normally — a Perception (3) Test notices the peg. Removable from its attachment plate. Sharpened, it fights as a hand spur, (Str+2)M (gamemaster decides whether the wearer keeps balance). Standard grade only. Replacing it with a real cyberleg follows the replacement rules (Street Samurai Catalog p.97). Street Index: always available. Cyberpirates p.174–175.
